_provenance.does_not_prove: that a divergence is executable or worth anything — running the sequence against these bytecodes does that, which is what real_market_fee.rs is. Nor does it price the chain's trading pools: the log query is filtered to this venue set. Chunks the node refused are in uncovered_blocks.
_provenance.how: every log the 101 pools of the census's 50 multi-venue token pairs emitted between their own PairCreated block and this head, in 5000-block chunks, typed by topic-and-data shape rather than by a remembered hash; then token0, token1, getReserves, the pool's own LP totalSupply and that LP's balance in the wallet the pool reports as its creator, all at the one head block
_provenance.proves: which of the pools a same-pair cycle would have to use has ever had a counterparty, what each venue's reserve ratio is at one pinned head, and whether the seeded liquidity's LP tokens still sit with the deployer
